test_design: Seven compressed full-shape metric packets were generated for four nadir and three oblique G11 observations. Each packet used the frozen triangulated G11 camera-z and internally consistent A/M1/M2/H tensors. All unprovided observations were intentionally left missing to test coverage accounting.
interpretation: The common evaluator completes without fitting a method-specific transform, enforces the mixed-view coverage gate, and preserves missing support as an explicit coverage failure. This does not unlock 3DGS training; actual renderer/export integration on the frozen cameras remains pending.
